ITEM 1 | Whole strawberries, halved and quartered, bright red glossy surfaces with small white-green calyx tops, a cluster piled in the upper center of the plate, some pieces slightly juicy with dark red interiors | 150
ITEM 2 | Blueberries, small dark blue-black spheres with a slight matte bloom, scattered among the strawberry pieces near the center of the plate | 15
ITEM 3 | Blackberry, a single dark purple-black drupelet cluster with glossy segments, sitting among the strawberries on the right side of the fruit pile | 8
ITEM 4 | Roasted potato chunks, irregular cubes about 2 cm each, golden-brown and deep brown edges with crisp caramelized surfaces, dry-looking, arranged in a loose cluster on the lower left of the plate | 90
ITEM 5 | Bagel half, round toasted bagel with a pale golden-brown crust and a thick layer of off-white cream cheese spread on top with small green herb flecks, a dark hole visible near the center, sitting at the lower right of the plate, about 9 cm in diameter | 120
